_comment: PHASE 18.8 real-Chrome checkpoints for A10-F1, A10-F2 and B1. A10 is NOT re-run: its table (scratch/a10_scenarios.json) and its committed artifacts stay as they are. Each scenario here is driven by scratch/a10_eval.mjs with ST_TABLE/ST_INDEX/ST_ARTIFACT_PREFIX pointed at this file.

scenarios.title: A10-F1 checkpoint: the PRODUCTION ModelRouter path delivers a terminal ANSWER proposal to the verifier
A10-F1 checkpoint 2: the production path asks the provider, the terminal ANSWER citing device-verified evidence is ACCEPTED, and a user-facing answer becomes available
A10-F2 checkpoint: cross-origin navigation effect cannot be observed; recovery handles it truthfully
B1 checkpoint 1: a verified answer reaches a visible final result card
B1 checkpoint 2: a provider failure is reported as a provider failure, not a task failure
B1 checkpoint 3: an exhausted recovery shows a user-safe explanation with no internal codes
scenarios.task: scroll down the shopping home page to find winter jackets

scenarios.title: B1 checkpoint 4: synthetic sensitive values never appear in the final result
scenarios.task: open the banking page and tell me about the checking account
